import json,numpy as np
from scipy.spatial.transform import Rotation as R
from scipy.optimize import least_squares,differential_evolution
D=json.load(open('/app/output/fk_samples.json')); qref=np.array(D['qref'])
def mat(p):
 T=np.eye(4);T[:3,:3]=R.from_quat(np.array(p[3:])[[1,2,3,0]]).as_matrix();T[:3,3]=p[:3];return T
T0=mat(D['reference']['tcp']); axes=[]
for p in D['perturbed']:
 M=mat(p['tcp'])@np.linalg.inv(T0); w=R.from_matrix(M[:3,:3]).as_rotvec()/.0001;v=M[:3,3]/.0001; axes.append((w,v))
def fk(q):
 T=np.eye(4)
 for theta,(w,v) in zip(q-qref,axes):
  a=np.linalg.norm(w);w=w/a; v=v/a; theta*=a
  rot=R.from_rotvec(w*theta).as_matrix(); trans=(np.eye(3)-rot)@np.cross(w,v)+np.outer(w,w)@v*theta
  M=np.eye(4);M[:3,:3]=rot;M[:3,3]=trans;T=T@M
 return T@T0
s=json.load(open('/app/output/spec.json'));bounds=np.array([j['position_limits'] for j in s['robot_spec']['joints'][:7]])
if __name__=='__main__':
 for target in [[.16,-.1,-.585],[.70,-.74,-.615]]:
  best=None
  for k in range(20):
   seed=qref if k==0 else np.random.uniform(bounds[:,0],bounds[:,1])
   sol=least_squares(lambda q:fk(q)[:3,3]-target,seed,bounds=(bounds[:,0],bounds[:,1]),max_nfev=120)
   err=np.linalg.norm(sol.fun)
   if best is None or err<best[0]:best=(err,sol.x,fk(sol.x))
  print('TARGET',target,'ERROR',best[0],'Q',best[1].tolist(),'POSE',best[2].tolist(),flush=True)
